annotations.text:
Behaviour is CLAUDE.md's, not this document's.

No score, no timer, no streak. The tapped card gets the same gold highlight whichever it was, held 600ms, then auto-advance. Nothing on this screen ever says right or wrong.

DESIGN.md's practice round (feedback on 2-3 warm-up items) is NOT drawn here: CLAUDE.md wins where the two touch, and it says the child is never told.

One star per question, right or wrong. Stars sit beside the store so a child who cannot read the label still learns what they are for.

The star count IS the progress indicator - one star per item answered.
